Tīmatanga tere
1. Tāutahia a Torque Pro (te putanga utu; kāore a Torque Lite e tautoko monohanga) ka takiruatia tō urutau OBD-II.
2. Whakahohea tēnei monohanga i Torque → Tautuhinga → Monohanga.
3. Tukua ngā whakamōhiotanga, ā, whakatakotoria te whakamahi pūhiko ki Kāore he rāhuitanga kia taea ai e Torque te tīmata i tēnei monohanga i te papamuri.
4. I Torque, tīpakohia te kōtaha waka mō te motokā e taraiwa ana koe. Ka puritia ngā raraunga mō ia kōtaha Torque, ā, ka tirohia ki te tuakiri VIN/ECU o te waka.
5. I te kōtaha hōu ka kitea te pūtake hinu ina tūhono koe; ki te pātaitia, whakatauritea ki te ine i te papatohu ka pāwhiritia Whakaū. Kei te whārangi tatūnga, kei te whakamōhiotanga hoki a Whakaū. Ka taea hoki te tīpako i raro nei.
6. Ko te rahi o te taika te rahi tīmatanga mō te urutau Chunk kia ako ra anō i tōna ake. Kāore te monohanga e huri i tērā; ka whakaaturia te rahi kua akohia o ia urutau i raro iho.
7. I Torque, tāpirihia ngā ine mō [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level me, mō ia urutau, Corrected %, Remaining, DTE me Tank size. Ko DTE ko Remaining whakareatia ki te mpg wā-roa o Torque. E kī ana tētahi pānui i te wā whakahou ka pānui taua urutau i te 1:1 kia mutu rā anō te whakahou.
8. Whakahokia te taumata hinu ki a Torque: Weto, Rēmana, Whakatika rānei mai i te urutau Chunk, Band, Kalman rānei ki tō ine 012F.
9. Ka tatauria te hinu anake i te wā e rere ana te mīhini. Ka rere te monohanga anake i te wā e tūhono ana a Torque ki te ECU.
10. Haere tonu ki te taraiwa, ki te whakakī; ka tipu te tika i roto i ētahi taika wāhanga. Ki te puta te whakamōhiotanga Kōtaha waka hē?, kōwhiria he aha mō taua haerenga.
11. Ka noho ngā raraunga katoa ki tēnei waea. Kāore he GPS, he tauwāhi rānei e tāruatia ana.

Whakaaturia te taumata hinu i te whakamōhiotanga
Whakahokia te taumata hinu ki a Torque (ka tuhirua i a 012F)
Kei te rere a Fuel Smoothing
Pāwhiria kia tīmata a Fuel Smoothing
I whakapeka te tīmatanga pūhiko, papamuri rānei. Huakina kia kotahi kia taea ai e te monohanga te rere me Torque.

Tāpirihia ētahi taika anō ina hiahiatia (ka noho tonu te taika wheketere 1). Kaua e tūhono i ngā pūoko ki te pine PCM FLI (whakakī teka). Ia taika anō me whai tana ake PID tāpiri Torque (MCU Mode 22, ingoa ahurei — ehara i te 012F, i a Ford 16C1 rānei). Ko te uara Select-PID te id taika timata i te 1. Ka namaa a Gal/hr ki te taika hohe anake.
Ko te rahi o te taika te rahi tīmatanga mō te urutau Chunk kia ako ra anō i tōna ake. Kāore te monohanga e huri i tērā; ka whakaaturia te rahi kua akohia o ia urutau i raro iho.

Ka tuhi i tētahi uara ki te Fuel Level tūturu a Torque (012F) kia whakaatu ngā ine o nāianei: Weto, Rēmana, Whakatika rānei mai i te urutau Chunk, Band, Kalman rānei. Ko te urutau kāore anō kia hangaia ka tuhi i te taumata rēmana.
Me Torque Pro (utu). Kāore a Torque Lite e tautoko monohanga.
Takiuru kōrero (patuiro; rārangi takiuru ia hēkona)
Te ingoa o tēnei kōtaha waka. Ia kōtaha waka Torque ka whiwhi i tana ake kōtaha monohanga, ōna ake raraunga me ngā mahere kua akohia.
Waitohu waka (hei tauira Ford). Ka whakamahia anake hei kōwhiri ko ēhea PID hinu motuhake o te waitohu ka whakamātauhia e te tautuhi.

Nō hea te taumata hinu mata. Tautuhi (me tūhono te ECU) ka whakamātau i ngā kaitono pānui anake, ā, ka tono kia whakaū engari kia rite ngā pūtake e rua. Kei te whārangi tatūnga, kei te whakamōhiotanga hoki a Whakaū. Kāore = tautuhi i te tūhononga o muri.
Mō te pūtake «PID tāpiri Torque mā te ingoa roa» anake: te ingoa roa tika o te PID Torque e pūrongo ana i te taumata.
putu = kāore he rahi tīmatanga; ka ako ia urutau i tōna ake.
